text.content:
They protect the people who work the clubs.

Turf: Wherever their workers are; based at Lizzie's Bar, Kabuki
Known for: Protecting sex workers
Rivals: The Tyger Claws

One of the newest gangs, formed in 2067 after the Tyger Claws murdered Elizabeth "Lizzie" Borden for standing up for her workers. The Mox exists to protect sex workers from exploitation.

Its leadership has hardened over the years and now protects only those who work for it directly, and some worry the Mox is becoming what it was formed to fight.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.26
